content.value_statement: WABA onboarding can mix incompatible signup paths, credentials, and callback contracts. This skill guides secure Sent profile setup, verification, testing, and failure recovery.
actual_capabilities: Distinguishes dashboard Embedded Signup, organization WABA inheritance, and dedicated child-profile credentials.
Explains profile and organization API-key authentication rules.
Defines profile creation requirements for inherited and dedicated WABA paths.
Guides profile completion and callback event handling.
Provides readiness checks for mappings, templates, webhooks, and secret redaction.
Routes common authentication, credential, mapping, and completion failures.
limitations: Does not launch Meta Embedded Signup or call Sent APIs.
Does not create, exchange, validate, or store access tokens.
Relies on current Sent and Meta documentation for changing contracts.
Requires the documented Sent mechanism to verify callback authenticity.

use_cases.title: Design Organization Onboarding
use_cases.description: Choose dashboard signup or shared WABA inheritance, then document prerequisites, tenant boundaries, and launch checks.

use_cases.title: Implement Dedicated Profiles
use_cases.description: Prepare secure child-profile creation, credential handling, number mapping, completion callbacks, and sandbox testing.

use_cases.title: Resolve Onboarding Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose authorization errors, missing WABA prerequisites, incorrect mappings, expired tokens, and incomplete callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Signup Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain which Sent WABA onboarding path fits an organization needing its first account. Include prerequisites and safe next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Inheritance Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist for a child profile inheriting the organization WABA. Cover authentication, sandbox testing, completion, and callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Dedicated Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dedicated WABA onboarding design: [design]. Identify credential, tenant mapping, callback, status, and rollback risks.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Operations Runbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a runbook for [tenant model]. Compare paths, define records, route failures, preserve audit evidence, and set launch gates.

output_examples.input: Our organization has no connected WABA, and a child should share one.
output: Start with organization Embedded Signup in the Sent dashboard.
Confirm the organization WABA connection before creating the child.
Create the child without dedicated WABA credentials.
Validate tenant boundaries, mapping, completion, and callback delivery.

output_examples.input: A dedicated child profile remains submitted after completion returned 202.
output_examples.output: Treat 202 as processing confirmation. Check prerequisites and verified callback evidence, preserve unknown statuses, and avoid declaring failure prematurely.

output_examples.input: A profile key receives 403 while using the child-profile header.
output_examples.output: Remove the child-profile header when using a profile key. Use an authorized organization key only when operating across an existing child profile.

best_practices: Select the onboarding path before designing requests or credential storage.
Inject tokens server-side, redact logs, and retain only secret-manager references.
Test in sandbox and verify mappings, callback authenticity, idempotency, and tenant attribution.
anti_patterns: Do not invent a public Sent endpoint for hosted Embedded Signup.
Do not expose WABA tokens through browsers, logs, fixtures, errors, or support output.
Do not treat profile completion, Meta browser messages, and message webhooks as one event contract.

faq.question: Can this skill start Embedded Signup?
faq.answer: No. Organization Embedded Signup starts in the Sent dashboard through the hosted Meta flow.

faq.question: When should a child inherit the organization WABA?
faq.answer: Use inheritance when the tenant should share the connected organization WABA and its operational boundary.

faq.question: Which dedicated WABA fields are required?
faq.answer: The WABA identifier and access token are required. The phone number identifier is optional under the documented provisioning behavior.

faq.question: How should access tokens be handled?
faq.answer: Receive tokens server-side, inject them from a secret manager, redact logs, and never return them to browsers or support channels.

faq.question: Does a 202 response mean completion succeeded?
faq.answer: No. It means background processing started. Use verified callback evidence to determine later status.

faq.question: Can a profile key use the child-profile header?
faq.answer: No. Only an authorized organization key may use that header for an existing child profile.
